pages.title: Coal Singularity
pages.text: An enormous pile of coal compressed into one point, pure carbon squeezed far past the pressure at which coal becomes diamond. It is jet black, and the stored chemical energy of ancient forests is almost palpable.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Coal is carbon from ancient plants, so I crushed vast amounts of it in the Singularity Compactor. It passed through graphite and diamond and kept going until it was a single point.
